principles: no wildcard resource where the service supports resource scoping
deployment_capabilities_to_review_later: manage only named EventPulse lab resources
pass only the EventPulse runtime role
read and conditionally own the dedicated state and lease objects
runtime_capabilities_to_review_later: write immutable objects to the selected S3 prefixes
emit selected CloudWatch logs and metrics
stop_condition: Any required capability not justified by a reviewed Terraform resource or any observed permission outside this proposal blocks Stage 2.
